verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs explicitly state the scrape endpoint returns content as markdown, HTML, or structured JSON in a single call (firecrawl-docs-1), and SDK docs confirm a single scrape call handles this (firecrawl-docs-14). A community comment (firecrawl-comm-4) notes HTML isn't returned in a separate 'daemon mode', but this is a distinct mode, not the primary scrape API, so it doesn't concretely contradict the core claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of HTML output quality/fidelity, and no direct third-party test confirming raw HTML retrieval via the standard API.
